summary: Meta researchers describe a method for training code models via reinforcement learning to optimize execution speed rather than just correctness, introducing a new benchmark (DMC-Optim) and reward/RL adaptations, showing gains on Qwen 2.5 7B and CWM 32B.

practices.reason: The paper introduces DMC-Optim, a new benchmark and calibrated sandbox for measuring code execution speed, which a team could adopt to evaluate optimization-aware models.
practices.quote: how code is tested, by building DMC-Optim with large optimization tests and a calibrated sandbox
